beschreibung:
Setting boundaries with your kids is not about being mean. It is about teaching respect, emotional regulation, responsibility, and the difference between having feelings and acting disrespectfully. In this episode, Nesha G and Moelethal talk about parenting through real life, from broken bones and big feelings to screen-time rules, household standards, and kids learning that every choice has a consequence.
The episode opens with a packed family week: Mini-Booski double fractured her foot right as gymnastics season was gearing up, Nesha competed in her first powerlifting competition, hit new platform PRs, and the family pushed through another busy August. From there, the conversation shifts into what it really looks like to set boundaries with children while still making them feel loved, heard, and protected.
Nesha and Moe discuss why kids can be upset without being disrespectful, why parents should not make consequences they will not enforce, why screen time and social media need strict limits, and why children need a voice but not always a vote. They also ask whether being the breadwinner is enough of a parenting contribution and close with Our 2 Cents stories about stay-at-home parenting expectations, student loans, and a wedding cake gift that got out of hand.
